ruleDefinitions.name: Firewall Disabled via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects netsh commands that turns off the Windows firewall

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*opmode.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*disable.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*advfirewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*state.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*off.*")))
